messages:
neha: quick follow-up idea from the RFC thread: introduce a tiny capability handshake so runtime doesn't have to guess if a bundle is streamable/atomic-swap/per-chunk-decrypt.
ryan: yes. we keep special-casing safetensors, tarballs, quant sidecars. a formal caps object would save us a lot.
olga: what would the payload look like?
neha: manifest-level hints + a CapProbe endpoint on loaders. example (informal): manifest: loader_caps -> streaming=true, atomic_swap=false, checksums=[sha256], decrypt_modes=[aes-gcm]. runtime: GET /capabilities?bundle=... loader -> {streaming:true,atomic_swap:false,max_prefetch:3,warmup_hint:low,approx_open_latency_ms:40}
samir: note: treat manifest hints as "what the bundle supports" and CapProbe reply as "what this worker instance can do right now". runtime merges them for decisioning.
ryan: fallback options we discussed: 1) cheap polyfill/convert 2) route to compatible pool 3) degrade behaviour (no streaming) 4) fail fast with remediation link. rank by cost.
olga: add an "enforce" flag for critical models (e.g., enforce_atomic_swap=true) so ingestion or rollout can block if requirements unmet.
neha: migration: older bundles without loader_caps -> runtime assumes conservative defaults (no streaming, no atomic swap). ingest pipeline should run a manifest-enricher probe to synthesize caps when possible.
samir: security: when advertising decrypt_modes only expose algorithm families (aes-gcm) not key ids. no secrets in caps.
ryan: telemetry: emit negotiation events with required_caps, available_caps, chosen_fallback, estimate_penalty_ms, model_version. feed those to Optimize.
neha: action items: 1) draft small schema RFC for loader_caps 2) implement CapProbe in loader shim 3) add manifest-enricher in ingest 4) runtime negotiation + telemetry + rollout gate (start permissive -> flip enforce after observing mismatch metrics).
runtime-bot: created issue ML-1289 (loader-caps RFC) and assigned neha/olga/samir. https://go/repo/ML-1289
olga: i'll draft schema examples for safetensors-sharded, tarball, quant-sidecar. samir will PoC CapProbe.
neha: will open the RFC PR today. thanks all :)
